question: In 2022, Air India was privatised. Which of the following private business groups has taken over Air India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TATA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Air India was officially handed over to the Tata Group on January 27, 2022.
 
• The Tata Group won the bid for Air India with an enterprise value of Rs 18,000 crore.
 
• This acquisition marks the return of Air India to the Tata Group after 69 years.
 
• The Tata Group had originally founded Air India in 1932 as Tata Airlines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tata Group:**

 
 
• One of India's largest and oldest conglomerates, founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata.
 
• Operates in over 100 countries across six continents in sectors like steel, automobiles, IT, telecommunications, and hospitality.
 
 
 
• **Air India:**
 
 
• Founded by J.R.D. Tata in 1932 as Tata Airlines; became Air India in 1946.
 
• Nationalized in 1953 and operated as the national carrier of India.
 
 
 
• **Privatization of Public Sector Enterprises:**
 
 
• Refers to the transfer of ownership, management, and control of public sector enterprises to the private sector.
 
• Aimed at improving efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.
 
 
 
• **Indian Aviation Sector:**
 
 
• One of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world.
 
• Has seen significant growth due to rising incomes, increased tourism, and government policies.
